s028000.name: Table: bit masks
summary: Eight single-bit masks, $80 down to $01.

DropReservedItem.name: Drop item from item box
summary: JSL entry. If the item box holds an item, empties it and spawns the item as a falling sprite at screen X + $78, Y + $20.
If all 12 sprite slots are full, overwrites slot 10 or 11 (alternating); frees a carried P-balloon's flag.
Preserves X. Called when Mario powers down.

DropRiFindSlot.name: Find free sprite slot for dropped item
summary: Searches slots 11..0 for status 0; if none, picks slot 10 or 11 by toggling [$1861] (clearing [$13F3] if it was a carried P-balloon).

DropRiHaveSlot.name: Create falling item sprite
summary: Sets the slot to status 8, sprite number = item + $73, initializes it, positions it near the top of the screen and sets [RAM_BlinkFallFlag].

DropRiEnd.name: Drop item: restore X and return

BombExplosionX.name: Table: explosion puff X offsets
summary: Two sets of five signed offsets for the Bob-omb explosion puffs (set 1 = indices 5-9).

BombExplosionY.name: Table: explosion puff Y offsets
summary: Two sets of five signed offsets for the Bob-omb explosion puffs (set 1 = indices 5-9).

ExplodeBombRt.name: Bob-omb explosion sprite main
summary: JSL entry for the explosion sprite; calls ExplodeBombSubRt.

ExplodeBombSubRt.name: Bob-omb explosion: timer and clipping
summary: Makes the sprite unstompable with the explosion hitbox, advances the animation counter and frees the sprite when [$1540] runs out; otherwise draws via ExplodeBombGfx.

ExplodeBombGfx.name: Bob-omb explosion: damage and graphics
summary: Every 8 frames kills sprites in range; while $10 <= [$1540] <= $2F hurts Mario on contact.
Draws five 8x8 puffs (tile $BC) whose offsets accumulate from BombExplosionX/Y so the cloud expands, with palette cycling 0-3.

ExplodeSprites.name: Explosion: loop over sprites
summary: Checks sprite slots 9..0 (not the exploding sprite itself) that are alive (status >= 8) with ExplodeKillSpr.

ExplodeLoopStart.name: Explosion: sprite loop body
summary: Per-slot test for the loop in ExplodeSprites.

ExplodeKillSpr.name: Explosion: kill sprite on contact
summary: Kills sprite Y (status 2, Y speed $C0, X speed 0) if it overlaps the explosion hitbox and is not immune ([$167A] bit 1).
Parameters: X = explosion sprite, Y = target sprite.

s0281CF.name: Table: background sprite Y positions
summary: Parallel to the X position table.

s028226.name: Table: background sprite tile numbers
summary: Parallel to the X position table.

s02827D.name: Draw parallax background sprites
summary: JSL entry, called every frame from CODE_009A6A while a special boss-room level runs. Probably draws a field of background decoration sprites (purpose unclear).
Computes scroll offsets at 1x, 1/2x and 1/4x speed, hides ten spare OAM slots, then writes OAM X/Y/tile/attributes for 57 sprites (30 if [$1884] = 1) from the data tables.
Sprites with X >= $F0 are duplicated into a spare slot with the X high bit set so they wrap around the screen edge. Tiles are only written once ([$188C]).
Unless [$1884] = 1, four of the sprites flicker every 4th frame (random tile swap). Ends by running the falling column code.

s0283C8.name: Table: OAM offsets for sprites and columns
summary: $0283C8: OAM offsets of the four flickering sprites. $0283CC: OAM offsets of the two falling columns.

s0283CE.name: Falling columns: move and draw
summary: Handles two column objects ([$18A8,X] state: 0 off, positive falling, bit 7 set landed; [$18AA,X] Y position).
Falling columns freeze sprites and Mario, accelerate until Y = $B0, then shake the ground (timer $30) and play sound $09; a landed column is drawn as nine 16x16 segments.
Purpose not confirmed; possibly a falling-pillar boss attack.

SubHorzPosBnk2.name: Mario horizontal position vs sprite
summary: Returns: Y = 0 if Mario is right of (or level with) the sprite, 1 if left; $0F = low byte of X distance.

IsOffScreenBnk2.name: Check if sprite is off-screen
summary: Returns: A = [RAM_OffscreenHorz] OR [RAM_OffscreenVert] (non-zero when off-screen).

s028510.name: Table: lava splash particle values
summary: $028510: X speeds, $028518: Y speeds, $028520: values for [$176F].

s028528.name: Spawn splashes, sparkles and Throw Block
summary: $0284A6-$0284E7: water splash spawners (three splashes for a dolphin jumping out, otherwise one).
$028528: spawns five lava splash extended sprites with random speeds. $02858F: spawns a minor extended sprite 5 at a random point on Mario (probably star sparkle).
$0285DF: spawns minor extended sprite 4 at a random point near the current sprite. $02862F: spawns a Throw Block sprite carried by Mario.

ShatterBlock.name: Shatter block into four pieces
summary: Spawns four brick pieces (minor extended sprite 1) around the block at [RAM_BlockXLo]/[RAM_BlockYLo], plays sound $07, and reuses slot [$185D] if all 12 slots are busy.
Parameters: A = value stored in each piece's [$1850]. Preserves X.
